end.summary:
- Practised naming polygons by counting sides.
- Identified pentagon, octagon, hexagon, triangle, and quadrilateral.
- Recognised that tilted or differently sized closed shapes remain the same polygon.
- Used the idea that a polygon must be closed and have straight sides.
- Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming polygons by their number of sides and recognising triangles and polygons in different positions. Veer used counting and checked whether shapes were closed; they also explained why a tilted six-sided shape is still a hexagon and why an upside-down shape is still a triangle. There was a brief mix-up between vertices and sides, and it was not clearly corrected later. At home, ask Veer to name everyday closed shapes by counting their straight sides.
